note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled 31 May 1911. Filed from the nomination list (Armagh Guardian, 28 April 1911, p. 2), the withdrawals (Armagh Guardian, 5 May 1911, p. 3) and the results of the contests in Ballyards, Clady, Grange, Lisnadill and Middletown (Armagh Guardian, 2 June 1911, p. 3). Not filed: Armagh Rural (6 nominated) and Tynan (3), whose withdrawals were not found, and Crossmore, where W. Menary withdrew leaving a contest between A. Gordon (U.), R. Watson (U.) and Peter Mooney (N.) whose result was not found. Labels are printed only for the Armagh Rural and Clady nominees and in some results. Polled 31 May 1911. Two seats; the first two elected. Five were nominated (Armagh Guardian, 28 April 1911, p. 2); three went to the poll.
